title: The beaked plague doctor

title: Harvey and the circulation of the blood
scope notes: De Motu Cordis 1628; quantitative argument; Malpighi's capillaries 1661; little change to therapy

title: John Graunt counts the dead
scope notes: Natural and Political Observations 1662; Bills of Mortality; first life table

title: Hooke, Leeuwenhoek and the invisible world
scope notes: Micrographia 1665; animalcules 1674–1683; no one connects microbes to disease for 200 years

title: The first blood transfusions
scope notes: Lower (dogs 1665–66), Denis lamb-to-human June 1667; deaths and ban; Blundell 1818–29

title: The royal touch
scope notes: Monarchs touching for scrofula ('king's evil'); Charles II touched ~90,000; ended 1714 England, 1825 France
